_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in the key. config.json is gitignored so the key is never committed. When hosted, set PDEX_API_KEY as a secret instead and leave this blank.
_pdex_api_key_help: Open https://www.pds.com.ph/wd-mp/php-bval-reference-rate-benchmark-tenors in Chrome, press F12, open the Network tab, reload, click the request to /api-mp/graphql/ and copy the value after 'APIKey ' in the Authorization request header.
